batch_situation: Tess has one funded take-home repair-kit allocation this week. Supplies sometimes fail to arrive; the posted cancellation is known in advance. This is separate from the store shift. Basic store work remains available.

work.label: Complete the kits at home
work.tradeoff: $24, or $28 with employment standing 3; two actions. Needs one observed repair completion or existing room arrears. One allocation per week, no travel required at home.

negotiate.label: Request a later delivery
negotiate.tradeoff: One request and one action. Standing 1 secures tomorrow through the following day at the same rate; standing 0 is refused. No advance wage. An accepted deadline creates a commitment.

decline.label: Leave the allocation for someone else
decline.tradeoff: No wage, debt or standing penalty. Other work remains available.

withdraw.label: Withdraw from the reserved delivery
withdraw.tradeoff: No wage. Employment standing and Tess standing each fall by at most one for this accepted commitment. Ordinary work remains available.

borrow.label: Request Tess's one support advance
borrow.tradeoff: $20 once per career, repay $20 within seven days. Requires a room shortfall or cash below $30 with a review within two days. Tess is at the cooperative on roster days 0, 2 and 5. No interest, automatic debit or eviction.

decline_help.label: Decline the support arrangement
decline_help.tradeoff: No money, obligation or relationship penalty. Store work and maintenance credit remain available.

repay.label: Repay the support advance
repay.tradeoff: Pay exactly $20 at home, once, and close the obligation. Tess records repayment; no new advance is unlocked.
